components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The compact, high-contrast action that sends visitors to a destination.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; background: var(--ink, #10233f); color: var(--white, #fffef8); font-family: var(--body, Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--signal, #ffd43b); color: var(--ink-deep, #09172b); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-deep, #8a6500); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Site Mark
components.description: The condensed uppercase identity lockup with its circular signal marker.
components.css: .ds-site-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; color: var(--ink-deep, #09172b); font-family: var(--display, 'Route Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-site-mark__signal { width: 0.8rem; height: 0.8rem; background: var(--signal, #ffd43b); border: 2px solid var(--ink-deep, #09172b); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-site-mark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-deep, #8a6500); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A compact unboxed navigation whose active state is a yellow route marker.
components.html: WritingWorkAbout
components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); color: var(--ink-deep, #09172b); font-family: var(--body, Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-site-nav a { padding-block: 0.4rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-site-nav a:hover, .ds-site-nav a[aria-current='page'] { box-shadow: inset 0 -0.22rem var(--signal, #ffd43b); } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-deep, #8a6500); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Status Board
components.description: A dark two-column directory with a signal-yellow heading and open-status labels.
components.css: .ds-status-board { background: var(--ink, #10233f); color: var(--white, #fffef8); font-family: var(--body, Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-status-board__header, .ds-status-board a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--board-line, #49607f); } .ds-status-board__header { min-height: auto; background: var(--signal, #ffd43b); color: var(--ink-deep, #09172b); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-board a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-status-board a span { color: var(--board-muted, #d8e2ef); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-board a:hover, .ds-status-board a:focus-visible { background: var(--ink-hover, #1d385d); } .ds-status-board a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-deep, #8a6500); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Route Row
components.description: The signature ruled destination row for work and writing entries.

components.css: .ds-route-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(5.5rem, 0.22fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem); align-items: center; min-height: 7rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #10233f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #a9b2ac); color: var(--ink-deep, #09172b); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-route-row:hover { background: var(--white, #fffef8); transform: translateX(0.35rem); } .ds-route-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-deep, #8a6500); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-route-row__code, .ds-route-row__destination { font-family: var(--display, 'Route Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-route-row__main { display: grid; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-route-row__main strong { font-family: var(--display, 'Route Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 3vw, 2rem); letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-route-row__main > span { max-width: 62ch; color: var(--muted, #526173); font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-route-row__destination { white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Prose Callout
components.description: A flat warm-white blockquote that emphasizes long-form content without elevation.
components.css: .ds-prose-callout { margin: 0; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; background: var(--white, #fffef8); color: var(--ink-deep, #09172b); font-family: var(--body, Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.overview:
Wayfinding Board treats the personal site as a clear public directory rather than an avatar-led portfolio. Its visual language comes from transit and destination boards: compact mastheads, condensed uppercase type, dark information fields, signal markers, and horizontal rules that make choices easy to scan.

The system is direct, high-contrast, and deliberately flat. Writing and work remain equally legible destinations, while the primary dark action points visitors toward work. The established anti-reference is the avatar-led hero paired with an equal-card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue structure on a warm paper field.
Signal yellow reserved for orientation, state, and emphasis.
Condensed uppercase display type paired with a neutral system body face.
Ruled destination rows instead of interchangeable cards.
Square-edged, low-decoration components with visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Signal Is Scarce Rule
rules.body: Use yellow for orientation and state, not as a general-purpose surface.

rules.name: The Route-Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve condensed uppercase type for identity, headings, codes, and destinations; keep explanatory copy in the body face.

rules.name: The Destination-First Rule
rules.body: Preserve a single reading axis and let rules, alignment, and column changes express hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat at rest; communicate grouping and state through color, rules, and motion.

dos: Do reserve Signal Yellow for navigation, focus, and state cues.
Do use ruled destination rows for comparable writing and work entries.
Do keep descriptive text within the established 55–72 character measures.
Do preserve the visible 3px keyboard-focus outline and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, gradients, glass effects, or soft card elevation.
Don't turn writing and work into an equal-card grid.
Don't replace the wayfinding introduction with an avatar-led hero.
Don't apply condensed uppercase display type to long-form body copy.
